valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (maridiveandoilservicessae) is served under two keys, EGS44012C010.CA PE 5.66 and MOIL PE 5.86, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 4.70256e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a compound growth rate of earnings is not defined from the periods on file: it needs net profit POSITIVE in BOTH endpoint years (FY2022 and FY2025), and one of them is not. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the total-equity row the P/B divides is an order of magnitude from its own adjacent year (FY2025 2.59071e+08 against FY2024 -3.64996e+06), so the book value for FY2025 is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
